title: Film Thickness Measurement - Mounds Detection on Zeta-20
subtitle: Post-Planarization Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: David Okafor

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Zeta-20 system to detect and classify Mounds defects during post-planarization inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Dresden Fab 3 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Mounds defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Zeta-20 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Zeta-20
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Mounds
- Process Step: Post-Planarization
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Dresden Fab 3

This test case applies to all Zeta-20 systems deployed at Dresden Fab 3 for post-planarization monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Zeta-20
Software Version: v14.9.196
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_7nm_POST_PLANARIZATION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (64 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.1μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Zeta-20 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Mounds defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 114 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 99% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±0.7% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-05-20
Wafers Tested: 36
Total Defects Found: 3103
Defect Density: 987.72 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 6.1%
Capture Rate: 90.8%
Test Duration: 369 minutes
System Uptime: 96.6%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Zeta-20 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Mounds at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Edge-zone defect detection showed improved performance compared to previous revision.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
